messages:
Sara L: taking evening primary tonight, grabbing the 18:00 PT handoff. saw a small pager spike at ~16:40 — posting bot summary below. can someone be secondary 18:00-02:00 PT? i also want a shadow for the first hour while we validate the kv-cache warmup from today's rollout. pinging @tom @miguel @jessie. :wave:
Oncall Bot: [16:40] Pager: PGW-EMBEDS latency surge. 5xx rate increased from 0.01% -> 1.4% over 6m. affected pods: embeds-prod-{a,c,d}. auto-retries triggered, fallback to cpu-fallthrough engaged for 3% of requests. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.redwood/1752223333
Miguel R: i’m on PTO until tomorrow morning, cant do the whole window, sorry — can cover 18:00-20:00 if that helps. i’ll stay reachable for escalation.
Tom H: i can take full secondary for the window. will standby + keep pager audible. @sara do you want me to handle any immediate rollback if we see regression?
Sara L: thanks tom — yes please be ready to flip routing if latency > 500ms p50 for >5m. fallback plan: switch route to model-embeds-v2-quant for embeddings and scale up ded. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/embeds-pager-playbook
Jessie M: i’ll shadow first hour (18:00-19:00). i'll monitor traces and keep the postmortem prompt set ready in case we need to do a quick eval. also can watch the KV cache logs.
Tom H: acknowledged. sharing quick commands i'll use for a fast handback / switch:
```
# flip primary routing to v2 quant
redwood route set --service=embeds --target=model-embeds-v2-quant --reason="evening handoff mitigation"
# scale ded pool
redwood capacity scale --pool=ded-embeds-prod --replicas=6
```
Sara L: putting the short checklist here so we’re aligned: 1) tom = secondary full window; 2) jessie = shadow 18:00-19:00; 3) miguel = escalation cover 18-20 if needed; 4) i'll monitor customer-impact dashboard & ack pages.
Infra Bot: telemetry snapshot: latency p50/p95 = 120ms / 820ms at 16:42, 5xx spike correlated with model-cache misses. dash: https://telemetry.redwood/embeds/1752223333?s=16:30&e=17:00
Sara L: small note — deploy-bot scheduled a non-breaking config rollout at 19:30 (only routing flags). @deploy-bot any chance of postponing until after window?
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy 19:30 UTC -> config: routing-weight adjust for canary. deploy owner: @ops-release. If needed the job can be canceled with `deploy cancel 17522-opscan`.
Jessie M: please cancel if we still see jitter at 19:00. i’ll be on watch.
Tom H: quick Q — if we flip to v2-quant, does the console show token-cost delta? want to pre-approve cost bump in case it stays for >30m.
Sara L: yes console shows estimated delta; i'll approve up to 15% cost increase for the window. if we need longer, we’ll loop in finance.
Oncall Bot: [17:22] Note: create incident doc if we escalate past rollback. template: https://docs.redwood/incident-template. tagging: #inc-embeds
Sara L: perfect. final check: runbook steps i expect we might run (short):
1) validate consumer error rate + latency (console link above)
2) scale ded pool by +2 replicas
3) flip routing to v2-quant if p95 > 600ms for 10m
4) cancel non-critical deploys (19:30)
5) open an incident doc if customer impact > 0.5% failed requests for 15m
Tom H: all good from my side. i’ll keep audible pager and will message here if i take any action. :thumbsup:
Jessie M: i’ll post KV cache tail logs if i see regen events in the next 30m.
Sara L: thanks all — will post a quick handback note ~02:00 PT or when i pass primary off. leaving this thread pinned for visibility. :lock:
